Create and start an identity verification

items.docs: This endpoint allows you to create and identity verification. You should get a `201` response and the identity verification resource containing the `_links/verification_url`.

Creates an identity verification.

When this request is successful, you'll get a 201 response with the identity verification resource.
This endpoint allows you to get the detailed results of an identity verification.

params.name: identity_verification_id
params.description: ID of the identity verification to anonymize

items.docs: Anonymize the personal data of an identity verification with the specified ID.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to list all attempts of a verification.

Attempts are returned ordered by creation date, newest first.

The response is paginated (see [Pagination](#section/API-standards/Pagination) section).
You can navigate through pages using the `skip` and `limit` query parameters or by following the URLs in the `_links` object.
This endpoint allows you to create a new Attempt. It is possible when the identity-verification is in one of the following statuses `created`, `pending`, `capture_in_progress`, `retry_required`
This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details for a given attempt

params.name: identity_verification_id
params.description: The ID of the identity verification

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

items.docs:
Retrieves the assets associated with an identity verification attempt.
This includes face images, videos, and document images captured during the verification process.
Please note that videos are not exposed by default, contact your account manager to enable this feature.

The response is paginated (see [Pagination](#section/API-standards/Pagination) section).
You can navigate through pages using the `skip` and `limit` query parameters or by following the URLs in the `_links` object.

params.name: identity_verification_id
params.description: ID of the identity verification to notify

items.docs: This endpoint can be used to initiate a webhook call containing the latest event of an identity verification.

info.name: Retrieve PDF report of an identity verification

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to retrieve a PDF report containing all the information of the identity verification.

Please note that this report is only available for verifications in statuses `declined` and `approved` once you receive the `identity_verification_report_created` event.
